pages.title: RF Resonator Cell
pages.text: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. A standing radio-frequency wave rings inside, and each bunch of particles that crosses it at the right moment gets a kick forward. It is small, smooth and cold, and hums faintly when powered.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)To accelerate a beam I needed a resonator with no losses. In the Lattice Growth Vat I grew a cavity of Topological Insulator and Cherenkov Quartz in superfluid helium. The wave inside would not decay.
